title: Austin Sells City Lots, OKs Taxi Drivers
summary:
*   **City Property Sold to Residents**: Austin approved the sale of a city lot to Edward and Mary Williams for $693.94, with a significant portion to be paid through monthly installments.
*   **Land Acquired by Religious Group**: Another city lot was authorized for sale to the South Austin Assembly of God for $350, involving a down payment and monthly installments.
*   **New Taxi Driver Licenses**: Permits were granted to Arthur Arnold and Vernie Ralph Moore, allowing them to operate as taxi drivers.

Councilman Bartholomew moved that the permit be granted. The motion carried by the

Ayes :
Councilmen Bartholomew, Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
Absent: Councilmen Alford and Wolf
The application of VERNIE RALPH MOORE, 210 East 9th Street, for a taxicab driver's permit,
duly approved by the Acting City Manager, was submitted.
Councilman Gillis moved that the permit be granted. The motion carried by the following
vote: Ayes: Councilmen Bartholomew, Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
Absent: Councilmen Alford and Wolf
Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution and moved its adoption:
(RESOLUTION)
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: THAT Walter E. Seaholm, Acting
City Manager, be, and he is hereby, CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
: 651
authorized and directed to make and enter into a contract in writing with Edward Williams
and his wife, Mary Williams, for the conveyance by the City of Austin to the said Edward
Williams and Mary Williams of Lot 1, Block 3, Outlot 4, Division "0", in the City of
Austin, in consideration of the payment by them of the sum of $375.00 which has heretofore
been paid to the City of Austin on their oral contract of purchase from the City, and an
obligation of the said Edward Williams and his wife, Mary Williams, to pay the additional
sum of $318.94, together with interest thereon, at 6% per annum from November 1, 1944,
until paid, such deferred payments to be made at $5.00 per month, the first such payment
to be made to the City of Austin on December 1, 1944, and the sum of $5.00 on the first
day of each succeeding month until the purchase price, together with all interest thereon,
is fully paid; upon the receipt of which the City of Austin will convey its title to said
Lot to said parties.
Which motion, carrying with it the adoption of the resolution, prevailed by the following
votes Ayes : Councilmen Bartholomew, Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
Absent: Councilmen Alford and Wolf
Councilman Gillis offered the following resolution and moved its adoption:
(RESOLUTION)
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: THAT Walter E. Seaholm, Acting
City Manager of the City of Austin, be, and he is hereby, authorized and directed to enter
into a contract with Edgar Olfers, Trustee of South Austin Assembly of God, to purchase
Lot 4, Block B, J. E. Bouldin Subdivision, City of Austin, for the consideration of
$350.00, payable $50.00 in cash, and the balance in monthly installments of $15.00 each,
with interest on deferred payments at 6% per annum; and the City Manager is hereby
authorized and directed to execute for and in behalf of the City of Austin a special
warranty deed to said South Austin Assembly of God, conveying the above described property
upon payment in full of said consideration, all in accordance with the terms and
conditions of the contract of sale, a copy of which is attached hereto and made a part
hereof.
Which motion, carrying with it the adoption of the resolution, prevailed by the following
vote: Ayes : Councilmen Bartholomew, Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
Absent: Councilmen Alford and Wolf
There being no further business, upon motion, seconded and carried, the meeting was
recessed at 11:20 A. M., subject to call of the Mayor. APPROVED Jon Milla
